## IRangeOptions interface

Options for range queries and iteration.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface IRangeOptions 
```

## Remarks

All fields are optional. Omitting `start` and `end` iterates the full key space in lexicographic order. `transaction` is an LMDB-internal field used by [LmdbEnv](./lmdb.lmdbenv.md) to bind the range query to a read transaction for snapshot consistency.
